addressed_note: Session 2: added dark glow halo (glowwidth 7/9) behind name tags and speech, live. Evidence media/text-v4.png and media/text-v5-speech.png (speech bubble readable). Live frame median 1.2 ms, p95 2.7 ms. isless(Service) error is in the read-only NeverendingHost. Minor remaining: speech overlaps name tag, top-edge clipping.
summary: Font sizes were raised (18/22 px) and overdraw is on, but I could not verify it live (game socket was down) and the author's own screenshot shows low contrast on some tags, no pill, and no speech bubble at all. Frame p95 is over budget.

findings.what: Name tags still look thin: cream text with a 2 px dark stroke and no backing pill, as the todo asked ('dark rounded pill'). 'Gloop' and the top-left 'Pinchy' are faint and grey against the water and background; 'Pinchy' is clipped by the top edge of the 3D view.
findings.suggestion: Add a background (e.g. a semi-opaque dark pill or a larger stroke with a halo), clamp tags inside the viewport, and check against bright backgrounds such as water and sky.

findings.what: No evidence for speech bubbles, which are half of the todo. Neither screenshot shows a speech bubble. The 22 px / 2.5 stroke setting was never seen rendered.
findings.suggestion: Trigger a speech line and screenshot it over foliage and over sky.

findings.what: Frame time is over budget. Perf file shows frame median 27 ms but p95 40.9 ms (> 33 ms), render median 25.6 ms and p95 38.4 ms. The author claimed 'live 30 fps' without a measurement after the change. overdraw=true text with strokes may add to this.
findings.suggestion: Measure live_status() before and after the change and report it; if the text is the cost, reduce the stroke or update the text only when it changes.

findings.what: The live game was not running during review (no run/game.sock), so I could not take my own live screenshot or measure frame times. The dashboard in the author's screenshot also showed an agent error 'MethodError: no method matching isless(::Neverendin…' in the status panel.
findings.where: run/game.sock; Sprout status panel in media/text-v3.png
findings.evidence: live_screenshot error: the game is not running
findings.suggestion: Make sure the game is up at the end of a session, and look into the isless MethodError in the author's activity.

findings.what: The author's changes were made in the engine (dev/NeverendingGame/src/scenery.jl) rather than a plugin, so a hot reload may not apply them without a game restart, and v2 and v3 evidence are mixed. Sprout's name is still partly overlapped by its leaf.
findings.suggestion: Confirm the running game has the new code and place the tag above the tallest part of the creature.
